$schema: TMS Apidog post-processor setup (manual or Public Scripts)

configureBearerAuth.note: Components → Security Schemes → bearerAuth → Default Auth Value → Token = {{accessToken}}. Or set Auth on the API root folder to Bearer Token with {{accessToken}}.

processors.description: Visual alternative to the custom script — use Extract Variable instead of Custom Script if preferred.
Use Public Script or paste script content. Do not add both Extract Variable and Custom Script unless you disable one.

workflow: 0. Local SQL Server: run DatabaseMigrator on Scripts/Migrations/, then ./scripts/seed-database.ps1 (creates TST001). Start API on http://localhost:61173.
1. Import openapi/tms-openapi.json into Apidog (full API — all 8 modules).
4. Settings → Public Scripts → create scripts from scripts/*.js (or add Custom Script post-processors manually).
5. On POST /auth/login and POST /auth/refresh-token: Post-processors → + Add → Extract Variable OR Public Script 'TMS — Save Access Token'.
6. Set bearerAuth default token to {{accessToken}} (see configureBearerAuth above).
7. Send POST /auth/login with body { "code": "{{userCode}}" } — all secured endpoints then use the token automatically.
8. Optional: import test-scenario/auth-bootstrap.json for a login + about-me smoke test.
9. GET timing: import test-scenario/get-queries-timing.json and run the scenario. Regenerate: ./scripts/generate-apidog-get-timing-scenario.ps1
